versions.content: Service Name <UL_ Remote Sleep Indication> Syntax void <UL_ Remote Sleep Indication> ( Network Handle Type nm Network Handle ) Service ID [hex] 0x00 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Fr Nm Clusters. Non reentrant for the same Fr Nm Cluster Parameters (in) nm Network Handle Identification of the NM - Cluster Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This API service of an upper layer BSW module <UL> (e.g. Com M) is called by the Flex Ray Network Management to indicate to this upper layer BSW module that all other nodes in the cluster are ready to sleep (the 'Remote Sleep Indication'), as no NM - messages with an indication to keep the bus awake are rece ived in the Normal Operation State for a configurable amount of time determined by the FRNM_ REMOTE_ SLEEP_ IND_ TIME (configuration parameter). Available via <none>
